literal_meaning: নরম-নরম বা তলদেশে নরম অবস্থা নির্দেশক অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (onomatopoeic for mushy or soft base)
figurative_meaning_en: Indicating extreme softness, almost in a melted or mushy state
example_sentences_in_bangla: মাটির পথটা বৃষ্টিতে তলতল করে উঠেছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The mangoes have ripened to a mushy state.
The dirt path has turned squishy after the rain.
note: This idiom is often used in contexts of overripe fruits or soft soil, reflecting everyday Bengali rural life.
